Geographies Served Programs UNXT Programme District Bangalore State Karnataka District Bangalore States Karnataka Is a training programme for students in the final year of Government colleges and is conducted right on the premises of the colleges themselves. No fees are charged to the students and digital certificates are provided to the students on successful completion. The programme is recognised by Government agencies of Karnataka and Andhra Pradesh and guarantees employment. Spark Unnati Grassroots Accelerator Mission(SUGAM) Programme District Bangalore State Karnataka District Bangalore States Karnataka The SUGAM programme seeks to promote entrepreneurship among rural youth enabling them to develop local businesses. It facilitates the budding rural businessman with venture funds, mentorship, advice, skill updates and partners towards the journey of setting up a small business and prosper. It also conducts entrepreneurship bootcamps in collaboration with Deakin University to enhance skill and confidence. Unnati - Youth Empowerment and Social Transformation Program State Karnataka States Karnataka In just 35 Days a generation goes above poverty line forever. Unnati Program is a 35-day vocational training program offered to the underprivileged less educated, unemployed and economically backward youth with a guarantee of a job. Unnati enables inclusive growth. A very intense program covering 300hrs of training with blended learning. Every youth is taught English, Basic Computers, Tally, GST, Life Skills, Values and a core vocation depending on his or her education qualification. Shiksha - Economic Support / Scholarship State Karnataka States Karnataka Economic support to underprivileged children in various schools .
